title: Enhanced Detective: A Dual-Stage Proactive Defense Against Internal Poisoning Attacks in Financial Fraud Detection Using Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.17523v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: With recent developments in Artificial Intelligence (AI), the adoption of distributed learning paradigms such as Federated Learning (FL) has emerged. In simple terms, FL enables multiple entities to collaboratively train AI models without sharing local data. The FL paradigm is particularly valuable in privacy-sensitive settings, such as financial services, because it enables institutions to collaboratively improve fraud-detection models while keeping sensitive transaction data local. However, FL schemes are prone to security vulnerabilities, where malicious clients can poison local data or model updates and degrade the global model, and hence the performance of the resulting model might be affected. Therefore, in this work, we propose Enhanced Detective, a dual-stage robust aggregation strategy that combines Median Absolute Deviation (MAD), distance-based update filtering, and FedMedian aggregation. translated_title: 增强侦探：一种基于联邦学习的金融欺诈检测中针对内部投毒攻击的双阶段主动防御方法
translated_abstract: 随着人工智能（AI）的最新发展，诸如联邦学习（FL）之类的分布式学习范式应运而生。简单来说，联邦学习使多个实体能够在不共享本地数据的情况下协同训练AI模型。联邦学习范式在隐私敏感的场景（如金融服务）中特别有价值，因为它使各机构能够在保持敏感交易数据本地化的同时，协同改进欺诈检测模型。然而，联邦学习方案容易受到安全漏洞的影响，恶意客户端可以对本地数据或模型更新进行投毒，从而降低全局模型的性能，因此最终模型的性能可能会受到影响。因此，在这项工作中，我们提出了Enhanced Detective，这是一种双阶段鲁棒聚合策略，结合了中位数绝对偏差（MAD）、基于距离的更新过滤以及FedMedian聚合。在不平衡信用（数据集）上的实验……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了Enhanced Detective，一种结合中位数绝对偏差（MAD）、基于距离的更新过滤和FedMedian聚合的双阶段鲁棒聚合策略，用于在基于联邦学习的金融欺诈检测中主动防御恶意客户端的内部投毒攻击。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Enhanced Detective, a dual-stage robust aggregation strategy combining Median Absolute Deviation (MAD), distance-based update filtering, and FedMedian aggregation to proactively defend against internal poisoning attacks in federated learning-based financial fraud detection.
